puzzleText: You've been tailing Crooked Kenny all across the city for days now, and you think that Chief is right - he is planning a huge hack - but you have no idea who the target might be. Suddenly you receive a text message on your phone - DING! It says: ------------------------- I knows ya✱ been tailin me So I dun sum diggin✦ on u too I got ya phone number off da✵ dark web If ya wanna know who I'm plannin★ to hack next Text back the hidden PIN number in this msg ------------------------- Seems like your cover is blown. You don't have much of a choice now but to talk to him and try to find out some more information. Just one problem - you don't see ANY numbers in that message at all... What 4-digit PIN number should you text back to Kenny?
hint: Dealing with Crooks is an *asterisky business... (but why are they all different?)
title: Cover Blown
